name: io.rugmunch/pry
title: Pry — Web Scraping & Browser Automation MCP
description: Self-hosted web scraping MCP: scrape, crawl, extract, monitor, parse, screenshot, x402 pricing.

tools.name: pry_scrape
tools.description: Scrape any URL to clean markdown with a 9-tier anti-bot fallback chain (Cloudflare bypass).

tools.name: pry_crawl
tools.description: Crawl a website from a seed URL, discovering and scraping linked pages up to max_pages.

tools.name: pry_extract
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a URL using CSS selectors — cheaper than LLM extraction.

tools.name: pry_template
tools.description: Execute one of 110+ pre-built scraper templates (amazon, walmart, linkedin, etc.).

tools.name: pry_search_templates
tools.description: Search the scraper template catalog by keyword, category, or site name.

tools.name: pry_monitor
tools.description: Create a content-change monitor that notifies via webhook, Slack, or Discord.

tools.name: pry_compliance
tools.description: Score scraping legal risk from robots.txt, ToS, GDPR/CCPA, and PII exposure.

tools.name: pry_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a URL with company info, tech stack detection, and social profiles.

tools.name: pry_parse_document
tools.description: Parse a document (PDF, DOCX, image) and extract its text and tables.

tools.name: pry_screenshot
tools.description: Take a full-page screenshot of a URL and return it as a base64-encoded PNG.

tools.name: pry_x402_pricing
tools.description: Get current x402 pay-per-call pricing in USDC atomic units per tool.

tools.name: pry_referrals
tools.description: Get Pry's referral catalog — 60+ providers with revenue-attribution links.

tools.name: pry_token_launches
tools.description: Track recent token launches, deployer activity, and new mint intelligence (crypto).

tools.name: pry_cex_listings
tools.description: Monitor CEX listing announcements and delisting events for crypto tokens (crypto).

tools.name: pry_token_security
tools.description: Run token security checks — honeypot, mint authority, LP lock, holder distribution (crypto).
